content.value: Specialized tomes add a known compatible rune rather than choosing a random family. They work on Magic or Rare equipment; Magic equipment becomes Rare when the proposal is accepted. A matching family cannot be duplicated on the same item.
Hold Show Details and click the tome's name to open its article. Select a listed rune for its effect, tier values, equipment categories and other sources.

Abrasion supplies flat Physical Damage on compatible weapons or flat Armour on compatible armour. Flames, [[item/cranks-dungeons:cold_tome|Ice]] and Electricity supply local flat damage on compatible weapons or matching resistance on armour.
Ruin supplies Void Resistance on compatible armour and has no weapon result. Greater Ruin supplies Physical Damage taken as Void on compatible armour.

Greater damage tomes provide their supported extra-damage family on compatible weapons. Greater Flames, Ice and Electricity apply only to weapons. Greater Abrasion and Greater Ruin retain their separate armour effects. Inspect the tome's equipment categories.

Haste supplies Attack Speed on compatible weapons and Chestplates, or Movement Speed on Boots. Body supplies maximum Health on compatible armour. Armour affinity can restrict which material bases accept the result; the linked rune article lists those bases.

A specialized tome supplies its rune at the equipment's material tier: a T9 base receives a T9 rune. Ordinary and Greater specialized tomes use the same equipment-tier rule; their rune families can differ. [[article/rune_tiers|Material tier caps]] explains progression between bases.

Adding needs a free slot on the rune's prefix or suffix side. If that side is full, choose a rune on that same side to replace. A paid replacement shows old and new results; keeping the old rune still consumes the rolled tome.

Specialized tomes are rare thematic combat rewards. Open an individual tome article for the creature sources that can actually award it. Stronger loot-search bonuses can help eligible weighted drops, but never guarantee a tome.
